title: I don't recommend. It's a great idea
text: I don't recommend. It's a great idea. I tried everything to get these to stick to a variety of items.  I tried putting them on the shower door, the microwave and a mirror.  I could NOT get them to suction on even a little bit.  I don't recommend.  It's a great idea, but doesn't work.

product_metadata.title: InterDesign Metro Ultra Rustproof Aluminum Power Lock Suction Bathroom Hand Towel Bar Holder - Smoke/Silver
features: Adheres to shower tiles, mirrors and other smooth surfaces for easy installation
Lift, push and lock feature for secure adhesion to smooth surfaces.
Made of rustproof aluminum with plastic suction cups
description: The InterDesign Power Lock Suction Towel Bar requires no hardware or tools to install - the suction cups adhere to smooth surfaces like tile, glass, fiberglass and some metals and maintains a firm hold. Suction hooks attach by simply pushing the cup against a surface and locking the hook into place.
